description_en: Collection of general, non-technical orientation and tooling pages for contributors and new users. Includes: How to contribute to these modules (contribution guide), The Zone (beginner-friendly overview of using the Zone for R/Python/SAS), Using LLMs at StatCan (best practices for large language models), Automation on Windows (batch files and Task Scheduler), and Quarto Markdown (formatting text, code and content).
description_fr: Regroupement de pages d’orientation et d’outils générales, non techniques, destinées aux contributeurs et aux nouveaux utilisateurs. Comprend : Comment contribuer à ces modules (guide de contribution), La Zone (aperçu pour R/Python/SAS), L’utilisation des GML à StatCan (pratiques exemplaires pour les grands modèles de langage), Automation sur Windows (fichiers batch et Planificateur de tâches) et Quarto Markdown (formatage du texte, du code et du contenu).

indicators: Understand the project structure and where to propose changes.
Follow the contribution guide to submit issues and merge requests.
Use basic GitLab features (issues, MR) to collaborate.
Describe what the Zone provides and when to use it.
Apply basic automation using Windows batch files and Task Scheduler.
Format documents and code using Quarto Markdown conventions.
Recognize best practices when using large language models.
Apply safety and privacy considerations before using LLM outputs.
Follow organizational guidance for LLM-assisted tasks.

description_en: Series of self-paced R learning modules covering the fundamentals of R and RStudio, data types and structures, importing data (.csv and .sas7bdat), file paths and projects, summary statistics, missing values, basic functions, a high-level introduction to the tidyverse, dplyr verbs (count, group_by, ungroup, filter, select, mutate, if_else, case_when, arrange, relocate), and combining/joining data frames. Estimated total time (sum of modules): 22.5 hours.
description_fr: Série de modules R à rythme libre couvrant les bases de R et RStudio, les types et structures de données, l’importation de données (.csv et .sas7bdat), les chemins et projets, les statistiques sommaires, les valeurs manquantes, les fonctions de base, une introduction au tidyverse, les verbes dplyr (count, group_by, ungroup, filter, select, mutate, if_else, case_when, arrange, relocate) et la combinaison/jointure de data frames. Durée estimée totale (somme des modules) : 22,5 heures.

indicators: Navigate RStudio and use R projects effectively.
Write and run basic R scripts and functions.
Apply style conventions covered in the modules.
Import datasets from CSV and SAS formats into R.
Manage file paths and project-relative files.
Handle missing data and perform basic cleaning operations.
Use dplyr verbs (filter, select, mutate, group_by, summarise, join) to transform data.
Apply conditional logic (if_else, case_when) for recoding.
Combine data frames using appropriate join operations.

description_en: Collection of supplementary R topics: memory usage and management in R, connecting to databases (SQL/Oracle), open-source package update considerations, using SAS-like formats in R, weighted statistics (survey weights), reproducible projects with renv, advanced Git/GitLab topics (CI/CD, Pages, hosting R packages), deduplication of data, advanced dbplyr workflows, R package development, and PROC SQL in R. These modules elaborate on specialized workflows and tooling (no unified time estimate provided on page).
description_fr: Regroupement de sujets R complémentaires : utilisation et gestion de la mémoire dans R, connexions aux bases de données (SQL/Oracle), gestion des mises à jour des paquets open source, formats SAS en R, statistiques pondérées (poids d’enquête), projets reproductibles avec renv, Git/GitLab avancé (CI/CD, Pages, hébergement de paquets R), déduplication des données, workflows avancés avec dbplyr, développement de paquets R et PROC SQL en R. Ces modules détaillent des flux de travail et des outils spécialisés (aucune durée totale fournie).

competencies.competency: Memory and large-data handling in R
indicators: Explain how R uses memory and how that differs from SAS.
Apply strategies to work with datasets larger than available RAM.
Use chunking and other approaches to process large files.
Establish connections to SQL/Oracle databases from R.
Use dbplyr for remote (SQL) workflows and advanced queries.
Translate common R data operations to efficient SQL where appropriate.
Use renv to capture project dependencies and improve reproducibility.
Understand principles of R package development and publishing.
Apply GitLab CI/CD and Pages to support package delivery and automation.

description_en: Self-paced Python fundamentals covering concepts and components of Python, navigating VS Code, Jupyter notebooks basics, getting started with Python coding, basic data types and structures, operators, control flow (if-else, loops), functions and modules, package installation/use, virtual environments (conda, venv), and style conventions. Estimated total time (sum of modules): 22 hours.
description_fr: Modules Python à rythme libre couvrant les concepts et composants de Python, la navigation dans VS Code, les bases de Jupyter, démarrer en Python, les types et structures de données de base, les opérateurs, la structure de contrôle (if-else, boucles), les fonctions et modules, l’installation et l’utilisation des paquets, les environnements virtuels (conda, venv) et les conventions de style. Durée estimée totale (somme des modules) : 22 heures.

indicators: Explain Python language concepts and components.
Write basic Python scripts using standard types and control flow.
Create and use functions and modules for reusable code.
Navigate and use VS Code effectively for Python development.
Use Jupyter notebooks for exploratory analysis and reproducible examples.
Manage virtual environments and packages with pip/conda/venv.
Apply style conventions to improve readability and maintainability.
Organize code following modular design principles.
Document basic usage and dependencies for reproducibility.

description_en: A focused series on pandas covering high-level introduction to pandas, importing/exporting data, summary statistics, data location in memory, handling missing values, functions, relational operators, row filtering and column selection, data manipulation (assign/apply/numpy.where/case_when), sorting and rearranging columns, cleaning (drop/fill missing), groupby, index management and reshaping, combining/joins, and plotting. Estimated total time (sum of modules): 26 hours.
description_fr: Série axée sur pandas couvrant une introduction à pandas, l’import/export de données, statistiques sommaires, emplacement des données en mémoire, gestion des valeurs manquantes, fonctions, opérateurs relationnels, filtrage des lignes et sélection des colonnes, manipulation des données (assign/apply/numpy.where/case_when), tri et réorganisation des colonnes, nettoyage (suppression / remplissage des manquantes), groupby, gestion des index et remodelage, fusion/jointures et visualisation. Durée estimée totale (somme des modules) : 26 heures.

indicators: Import and export tabular data using pandas I/O utilities.
Use DataFrame methods to filter, select, mutate and reshape data.
Apply groupby-aggregate patterns and merges to produce analysis-ready tables.
Identify and handle missing values via dropna, fillna, and conditional logic.
Apply vectorized functions and numpy.where for performance-sensitive transformations.
Rearrange and sort data to facilitate analysis and downstream tasks.
Produce basic visualizations directly from pandas DataFrames.
Choose appropriate plots to summarize distributions and group comparisons.
Integrate plotting with data-preparation workflows for quick EDA.

description_en: Short, focused Python topic modules that include credentials & secrets management, querying SQL/Oracle databases, processing large files and memory management, SAS integration (saspy), SAS-like formats in Python, DuckDB overview, Jira connection example, creating web apps, web automation with Selenium, and sending email notifications. Estimated total time (sum of modules): 15.5 hours.
description_fr: Modules Python courts et ciblés couvrant la gestion des identifiants, les requêtes SQL/Oracle, le traitement de fichiers plus grands que la mémoire, l’intégration SAS (saspy), les formats SAS en Python, présentation de DuckDB, connexion à Jira, création d’applications web, automatisation web (Selenium) et envoi de notifications par courriel. Durée estimée totale (somme des modules) : 15,5 heures.
related_courses: Python Fundamental Modules, Python Pandas Modules

indicators: Recognize safe practices for storing and using passwords and tokens.
Use appropriate libraries or environment-based approaches to manage secrets.
Avoid embedding credentials in source code and configuration files.
Connect to SQL/Oracle databases and run queries from Python.
Stream query results into pandas or into on-disk processing pipelines.
Apply appropriate patterns to minimize memory pressure when ingesting large results.
Build simple web apps or automation scripts (Selenium) for repeatable tasks.
Send notifications (emails) programmatically as part of workflows.
Understand when to use DuckDB or saspy for specific workloads.

description_en: Progressive set of Git/GitLab modules covering introduction to Git/GitLab, cloning, pushing code, editing and pushing single and multiple files, staging, using Git in RStudio/VSCode, branching and merging, collaborating (forks and roles), GitLab issues and milestones, issue boards, merge conflict management, CI/CD pipelines, and advanced Git commands. Estimated total time (sum of modules): 15.5 hours.
description_fr: Série progressive de modules Git/GitLab couvrant l’introduction à Git/GitLab, le clonage, le téléversement de code, la modification et le téléversement d’un ou plusieurs fichiers, la mise en scène, l’utilisation de Git dans RStudio/VSCode, les branches et la fusion, la collaboration (forks et rôles), les tickets et jalons GitLab, les tableaux de tickets, la gestion des conflits de fusion, les pipelines CI/CD et les commandes Git avancées. Durée estimée totale (somme des modules) : 15,5 heures.

indicators: Clone repositories, stage changes, commit and push code.
Understand branching models and perform merges safely.
Resolve basic merge conflicts and use best-practice commit messages.
Use forks and merge requests to contribute to projects you don't own.
Manage issues, milestones and boards to coordinate work.
Apply role-based collaboration patterns on GitLab-hosted projects.
Recognize the purpose of GitLab CI/CD pipelines and how they integrate with repos.
Implement basic CI/CD pipelines for testing or publishing artifacts.
Understand how Pages and CI/CD can support reproducible deployments.

description_en: Collection of Parquet-related materials: an introduction to Parquet, Arrow and DuckDB; guidance on working with larger-than-memory files; R and Python read/write examples; chunking strategies for R; and tools to open Parquet files. These materials focus on efficient storage formats and patterns for working with large tabular data (no single total duration provided on page).
description_fr: Regroupement de ressources sur Parquet : introduction à Parquet, Arrow et DuckDB ; guide pour travailler avec des fichiers plus grands que la mémoire ; exemples de lecture/écriture en R et Python ; stratégies de morcellement (chunking) en R ; et outils pour ouvrir des fichiers Parquet. Ces contenus portent sur les formats de stockage efficaces et les méthodes pour travailler avec de grandes tables (aucune durée totale fournie).

indicators: Explain the purpose and benefits of Parquet and Arrow.
Select appropriate tools (Arrow-based readers, DuckDB) for workflow needs.
Open and inspect Parquet files using available tools.
Choose strategies for processing data that exceed available RAM.
Apply chunking and streaming patterns in R and Python when appropriate.
Integrate on-disk solutions (Parquet, DuckDB) into data pipelines to reduce memory pressure.
Use best-practice APIs to read and write Parquet files from R and Python.
Understand metadata handling and when to preserve schema information.
Combine Parquet workflows with existing ETL and analysis tooling.
